metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow still got that 1 poor soul? Valorant aim’s a mystery
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I forgot how to aim
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
How did that even connect? No idea but I’m cashing in

Tap if your aim ghosts you but still surprises you!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
